contributions.detail: Three Form A rows sum to 744.05: 400.00 + 100.92 + 243.13. That equals cover line 1 in BOTH the THIS REPORT and CUMULATIVE columns; the LAST REPORT cell holds a written numeral 0 (a digit, not a nil mark), so this is the first report of the cycle and the two scopes coincide -- recorded as cumulative per the addendum. Line 2 (the $50.00-or-less aggregate) is BLANK in all three columns, so no sub-$50 aggregate competes and reconciling against line 1 alone is unambiguous here. Generation-1 form -- no printed schedule total exists on the sheet, so the cover line is the only anchor. The two cents groups are the only doubt on the page and the sum settles them: 100.92 + 243.13 = 344.05, and 400.00 + 344.05 = 744.05 exactly.

expenditures.detail: Form B (page 3) is a WHOLLY BLANK ruled sheet -- the page exists, every writing line is empty, nothing is struck out. Cover line 3 is likewise BLANK in all three columns: the filer left the cells empty rather than writing a zero glyph, which under the repo-wide zero-glyph ruling is a blank, NOT a 0. So there is no printed figure to score the (empty) side against, and the result is 'unknown' rather than 'exact'. The side itself is an honest zero -- sides.expenditures = 'transcribed' with zero rows, not a gap and not a withholding.
